name: pyscn-analysis-baseline-reconciliation
instr:
pyscn cannot capture portable, versioned snapshots of project findings or compare later analyses with them. Add baseline capture and comparison without storing source text or changing ordinary analysis behavior.

Classify every eligible finding exactly once as new, unchanged, changed, resolved, or unavailable. Use stable project-relative identities for each reportable scope, symbol, source location, and nested finding. Analyzer-specific equivalence must compare all finding kinds, rules, severities, metrics, method groups, and metric populations across CBO, complexity, dead-code, DI anti-pattern, LCOM, and mock-data analysis. Filtering and selection define the population. Findings unobserved because an analyzer failed, was disabled, or excluded them are unavailable, not resolved.

Preserve analyzer result shapes, metrics, rollups, ordering, warnings, summaries, exclusions, diagnostics, and failure semantics. Use ordinary aggregate analysis's canonical snapshot and enabled analyzer population, including partial runs with balanced totals. Keep existing output unchanged without a baseline.

Valid baselines must round-trip without losing comparison data.
